ValueSet: Hybrid SNOMED CT and PSS/QSI Diagnostic Imaging Procedure

Official URL: https://www.ehealth.fgov.be/standards/fhir/terminology/ValueSet/be-vs-hybrid-diagnostic-imaging-procedure Version: 3.0.0
Draft as of 2026-10-28 Computable Name: BeVSHybridDiagnosticImagingProcedure

Copyright/Legal: This value set includes content from SNOMED CT, which is copyright © 2002+ International Health Terminology Standards Development Organisation (IHTSDO).

Diagnostic care services that can be prescribed for diagnostic imaging using SNOMED CT and PSS/QSI Codes.

References

This value set is not used here; it may be used elsewhere (e.g. specifications and/or implementations that use this content)

Logical Definition (CLD)

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Import all the codes that are contained in PSS/QSI Diagnostic Imaging Procedure
  • Import all the codes that are contained in eReferral/PSS Diagnostic Imaging Procedure

 

Expansion

Expansion from tx.fhir.org based on:

  • SNOMED CT International edition 01-Feb 2025
  • codesystem PSS/QSI Diagnostic Imaging Procedure v3.0.0 (CodeSystem)
  • valueset eReferral/PSS Diagnostic Imaging Procedure v3.0.0 (ValueSet)
  • valueset PSS/QSI Diagnostic Imaging Procedure v3.0.0 (ValueSet)

This value set has 1,451 codes in it. In order to keep the publication size manageable, only a selection (1,000 codes) of the whole set of codes is shown.
